notes.title: Great news with our Episode 0 Roundup!
notes.content: [p]Protectors! What can we say? It’s been an incredible Steam Next Fest and your unwavering support continues to inspire and motivate our team. You’ve been spending so much time with Omega in Ep.0 and it seems a shame to cut you all off, so we’re extending the Ep.0 demo until July 1st![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45353323/c948eb703d86622325cd666315a340837c6506aa.gif"][/img][/p][p]If you’d like to keep up with our project, and make sure you’re getting all of the demo, playtest and community action, make sure you follow and wishlist on the main Ovis Loop store and socials. You can find Ovis Loop on [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2226730/OVIS_LOOP/"]Steam[/url] (where every wishlist really helps us) as well as [url="https://x.com/lifuelgames"]X (Twitter)[/url] and even in our own [url="https://discord.gg/rRd7TgzGjj"]official Lifuel Discord[/url]![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45353323/39bb1f0497a5f09f2b52bad675e2d352dc4ed7ad.gif"][/img][/p][p]This STAND-ALONE project aims to give you a little insight and a lot more game to play, without spoiling Ovis Loop’s story, and giving you all a little something to be excited for when we release.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45353323/a243544ad948e3e9d68e08e06acc87fe8b12dc52.gif"][/img][/p][p]So, after a week, what did you get up to in our Ovis Loop STAND-ALONE Ep.0 demo?[/p][p]· Over 460 daily active Protectors were saving the flock at our peak[/p][p]· Wishlists surged far beyond our expectations (though, please make sure to also wishlist over on the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2226730/OVIS_LOOP/"] official Ovis Loop Steam store[/url] where you’ll find our full release)[/p][p]· You pushed us into the top 50 Steam Next Fest demos of over 3,000 different games![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45353323/208bdec8a1a121dbc819b1d860ae7c341c82d280.gif"][/img][/p][p]We hope that the extra time will let you enjoy our STAND-ALONE adventure up until July 1st. Importantly, the STAND-ALONE Ep.0 demo is just the first step of Omega’s journey. We’ll have some big news over on our Ovis Loop pages in the very, very (VERY) near future and we’d love to have you along for the ride.[/p][p][/p][p]Your passion, feedback and support drive everything we do here at Lifuel. Whether it’s in Episode 0, or over on Ovis Loop’s community forums and social media, we really hope to see you again soon.[/p]

notes.title: "STAND-ALONE Ep0" Live Streaming Session is now open!
notes.content: [p]Live Streaming Schedule: Starting now.  Live Streaming Frequency: 24/7 (Fingers crossed for a reliable computer, no internet or power cuts...)  Tune in to our live stream to explore the game content of "STAND-ALONE" with us! You can also interact and communicate with other players in a friendly manner.[/p]
